description: The file 'RequestHandlerTests.java' contains unit tests for the 'RequestHandler' class in the 'org.apache.ofbiz.webapp.control' package. It includes nested test classes that verify URI resolution, method matching, and SSL certificate checking functionalities within the request handling logic of the framework.

classes.name: RequestHandlerTests
classes.description: Unit tests for the RequestHandler class, covering URI resolution, method matching, and certificate verification.

classes.name: ResolveURITests
classes.description: Nested class containing tests for URI resolution logic based on request attributes, path info, and route configuration.

classes.name: ResolveMethodTests
classes.description: Nested class testing method resolution logic for various HTTP methods, including 'all' catch-all logic.

classes.name: CheckCertificatesTests
classes.description: Nested class testing SSL certificate presence and validation in requests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares mock objects and default behaviors before each test in nested classes.

methods.name: resolveURIBasic
methods.description: Tests basic URI resolution matching a request path to a route.

methods.name: resolveURIBasicPut
methods.description: Verifies handling of HTTP PUT method routing based on request method and stored route configurations.

methods.name: resolveURIUpperCase
methods.description: Checks case insensitivity in URI method resolution.

methods.name: resolveURIDefault
methods.description: Tests fallback to default request route if no request path matches.

methods.name: resolveTemplateURISergmented
methods.description: Verifies resolution of URIs with segmented paths and variables.

methods.name: resolveTemplateURIWithVariables
methods.description: Tests extraction of variables from URI path segments.

methods.name: resolveTemplateURIConflictingRoutes
methods.description: Ensures specific routing precedence when route patterns could conflict.

methods.name: resolveURIBasicOverrideView
methods.description: Tests route overlay when a view override is specified.

methods.name: resolveURIMissingOverrideView
methods.description: Verifies fallback behavior when override view route is missing.

methods.name: resolveURINoDefault
methods.description: Checks that resolution yields empty when no default route is configured and no match is found.

methods.name: resolveMethodBasic
methods.description: Tests method resolution logic for matching HTTP methods including 'all'.

methods.name: resolveMethodCatchAll
methods.description: Validates that catch-all method routes are matched when specific methods are absent.

methods.name: checkCertificatesFailure
methods.description: Ensures SSL certificate validation fails gracefully when no certificates are present in the request.

methods.name: checkCertificates22
methods.description: Tests successful detection of certificates following the Jakarta EE 2.2 spec.

methods.name: checkCertificates21
methods.description: Tests handling of SSL certificates following the Java EE 2.1 spec.

methods.name: checkCertificatesUnrecognized
methods.description: Verifies that unrecognized SSL certificate attribute names are ignored and do not cause false positives.
